Capture date: 2026-11-13 UTC (2026-11-12 Pacific). Native capture of multi-condition edit rules (plan 4c) in Org D, plus the custom-rule overfull search cases (plan Q3 case 12). The sharing and field access panel (plan 4b) is in ../q4c.
Org D: one fresh 30-day Developer Edition scratch org from a campaign Dev Hub. The standard Contact, Lead and Account duplicate rules were deactivated by metadata deploy (retrieved XML with isActive false) so only the probe rule under test ran. The Dev Hub active scratch record went from 1 to 0 after deletion and the local target no longer resolves (see the final line of this file).
Frozen predictions: Glade campaign/v039-duplicate-test-reliability 7b860d462 with GLADE_STANDARD_DUPLICATE_RULES=on, glade exec at API 67.0 with the same helper (frozen/predicted-R*_Alert.json, predicted-R*_Block.json, predicted-stage_q3c_*.json). Disclosure: the first stage run started while the stage generator was being corrected (rule sort order); the generator rewrote the stage folders and removed the first predicted files; all 14 predictions were regenerated from the identical helper and Glade head before any native observation was read.
Design (4c): custom Contact rules R1 to R6 and Lead rule R7, deployed one at a time (only the rule under test active), each with Alert on edit (actionOnUpdate Allow plus operationsOnUpdate Alert) and again with Block on edit (actionOnUpdate Block). Insert action is Allow with no operations, so seed pairs insert freely. Shapes: R1 one fuzzy Phone item, no filter; R2 one exact Email item; R3 fuzzy FirstName AND fuzzy LastName; R4 exact Email OR fuzzy Phone; R5 R1 with filter Title equals XT AND Department equals YD; R6 the same filter with OR; R7 R2 on Lead. Each rule runs one helper method with independent scenarios, each with its own seed B and edited record A, unique phone, email and name values per scenario: E0 unrelated field only; E1 matching field changed into a match; E2 matching field assigned its current value; E3 one of two matching fields changed while the other already equal (R3, R4); E4a matching field to null and E4b from null; E5 filter field enters scope with matching fields unchanged, E5b leaves scope; E6 filter enters scope and the matching field changes in the same edit; E7 before-update trigger rewrites the matching field (trigger source in frozen/); E8 changed to another matching value; E9 Database.update of two rows; E10s and E10l upsert by Id, scalar and list; E11new upsert by a missing external key into a match; E11existing upsert by an existing external key changed into a match. Contact.Ext__c and Lead.Ext__c (external ID, unique) and a permission set were deployed. Result tokens: S saved; D+ or D- duplicate detected with allowSave true or false and the matched seed labels. na means the scenario does not apply to the rule shape.
Q3 custom cases: Account custom exact rule (Name Exact) and custom fuzzy rule (Name CompanyName), each active alone with the standard Account rule inactive: customExact120 (120 identical seeds) and customFuzzy120 (every sixth seed exact, the rest a weaker name). Results are in ../q1q3/org.tsv, groups customExact and customFuzzy.
Routes: APIs 62.0 and 67.0, anonymous and @IsTest, each run twice; helper and test classes redeployed per API and ApexClass.ApiVersion read back through Tooling API. The driver fails on Apex log truncation or exhaustion text, missing or incomplete frames, class API mismatch. Every observation of every rule and action is identical across API, route and repeat (comparison-edits.tsv holds the unique value per scenario).
Result summary: on all 14 rule-and-action combinations the rule ran on an edit exactly when a matching field's value changed (E1, E3, E4b, E6, E7 with trigger rewrite, E8, E9, E10, E11existing); it did not run on an unrelated edit (E0), when a matching field was assigned its current value (E2), when a matching field was set to null (E4a) or when only a filter field entered or left scope (E5, E5b). Upsert by external key with a new key took the insert path (S, no rule operation on insert).
Final: d scratch deleted; active hub record 1 -> 0; local target no longer resolves
